anchor: supersonic superconductor/SKILL.md ## Supervision: "Surface to your partner only" and "Routine progress"
cookbook: https://docs.typesafe.ai/cookbooks/function_calling.md: a route Choice over a closed set of handlers; facts code can count (consecutive operator deaths) override in code, not in the model

event.description: the escalation, report, or event text (quoted evidence)

consecutive_deaths.description: consecutive operator deaths on this spec, counted from the ledger

instructions.question: Which kind of event does the quoted text in `event` report?
instructions.how_to_read: `event` is quoted evidence from an operator or agent. Classify what it reports, not how urgent it says it is.

criteria.unclear: The text does not show what kind of event this is
criteria.frame_event: It reports a binding, store, table family, consumer, or subsystem the design does not model, or a defect class that has now recurred a third time
criteria.requirement_contradiction: Two requirements in the design or specs contradict each other
criteria.scope_change: It proposes cutting scope or adding scope
criteria.blocked_design_change: A task is BLOCKED, and resolving it would change the design
criteria.repeated_death: The same spec's operator has died twice in a row
criteria.routine: Ordinary progress, a question the design doc and specs answer, or a fix-loop update

notes: Conservative = unclear, which falls back to the controller's own judgment, so a first-option bias can neither hide a frame event nor add an interruption. Any confident non-routine route is surfaced to the partner; routine goes in the wave-boundary summary.
